existingColumns.description:
Set of columns that already exist in the given row. If known, this information can be used during CAS (compare and set)
operation to check for existence

casFilter.description:
Compare and Swap filter. This should be used when the put operation should be applied based on
certain condition is met. E.g. "age == 5", the rows will only be updated if the value of the field age is 5.
Currently, only simple filters & updating fields on which conditional filters are to be applied are supported.

rangeRemoveQuery.description:
executes a range remove query on the underlying data store if supported. This is helpful to reduce overhead
of deleting one column at a time vs removing a range of columns
e.g. cols.(name >= 'some_col' && name < 'some_col')

subBatchingDisabled.description:
for put batch operations only, this determines if we should attempt to split the batch into smaller units
to avoid batch size limitations with the kv store. When this is not disabled, put batch operations are NOT
guaranteed to be atomic.

dataPointType.description: Data point type for which normalized timeseries operation is being performed

merge.description:
If set, columns are merged with existing columns. If new values with same column name are provided, existing values
in those columns will be overwritten

removedColumns.description: Removes the given columns. Used when removing invalidatedRange columns on normalization

skipColdBucketUpdate.description: If set, skips attempting to write to cold bucket during {@link NormalizedTimeseriesPersister#put} action if hot/cold storage is enabled

fullCompact.description:
If set, will attempt compacting of hot data into cold store as part of {@link NormalizedTimeseriesPersister#put} action. If the buckets
are not part of NormalizedTimeseries object, `put` will read the data from the hot store
If set, skipColdBucketUpdate will be ignored and the cold bucket will be updated

title: Indicates how normalized data should be written
name: NormalizedTimeseriesPutSpec
